title: Gaussian bivariate stability
statement: For real parameters $\rho,\alpha,\beta$, define the Gaussian bivariate stability as the probability that independent standard Gaussian random variables $X,Y$ satisfy $\Phi(X)\leq\alpha$ and $\Phi(\rho X+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}Y)\leq\beta$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian cumulative distribution function.
